runtimeMapping.basic: Native Attack_A/Attack_B literal .167s events alternate locally; changed mode uses Skill_3_Loop_A/B and one zero-delay derived hit on the retained victim. Offensive SP is per attack, plus the changed passive forced1 SP.
runtimeMapping.S1: Three native charges; a full cast clears all remaining SP and issues three hits at the single Skill_1_Charged event. Nonfull casts consume one charge and issue one hit. Original timeMode0 events/tail scale with ASPD.
runtimeMapping.S2: Native marked-target priority and cap; .367s Begin hit can lift marked WALK targets for2s. Begin .833s tail hands off to separate End .033s event, which selects all levitated targets in x-4, ends levitation, guarantees the source-owned talent mark and applies atk_scale_down. SP resumes in the End phase.
runtimeMapping.S3: Manual source type retained. Fifth activation changes to x-6 range with original Change/Idle/Loop clips. Subsequent normal attacks and skills have a zero-delay derived second hit/blast. Immediate native projectile .8 radius selects ground targets. Both charged blasts keep the first center; transformed ready skills auto-attempt each30Hz step.
runtimeMapping.talents: Source-owned2.5s final-damage amplification; normal hits roll independently and slam guarantees the mark. A skill kill adds a2s marker, refunded once at each skill/ability finish via forced SP gain. E1/E2 and potential5 tiers preserved.
runtimeMapping.interruption: Deployment sequence and control epoch invalidate unfired events. Mode/count reset on death; interruptions end casts and remove owned SP/disarm locks.

verificationLimits: Original MonoBehaviour graphs, five bundle hashes, all30 source ranks,146 native components,13 reachable templates and both delivered facing skeletons are byte-verified. Native C# bodies were not recovered.
Animation-event precision is preserved in evidence but local dispatch uses30Hz ticks. Native MultiAttack/MultiProjectile triggerDelta0 callbacks are mapped locally, not frame-certified.

Round-robin basic ability choice, same-hit talent application order, marked-target selector ordering, fifth-activation mode/count handoff and S2 Begin-to-End phase/refund timing are local mappings of recovered selectors/events. Authored PRTS gameplay notes supplement interpretation; native callback ordering remains unverified.
Transformed S3 readiness currently requires an eligible ground target. The blocked-air-target activation edge described in authored notes is not implemented.
Retained inputs are rechecked for targetability at local release. Native issued-ability behavior after concealment or invulnerability changes has not been certified.
Talent2 kill-marker lifetime is source2s. Native particle prefabs, audio, modules, all-frame game parity and physical-device touch behavior remain unsupported or unverified.
